title: Lecture 1 | Programming Paradigms (Stanford)
summary: The first lecture of Stanford's CS107 Programming Paradigms, taught by Jerry Cain, giving an overview of the course. The course goes from C and assembly through C++, concurrency, Scheme and Python.
why: Commenters rate the whole playlist as high-quality, clear teaching that builds foundations from memory and machine instructions up to different paradigms.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: The presentation is clear and it simplifies in just the right places to give you the foundations.
